label: About
title: About An Interval of Blue
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1442 recent saved-signal files and 1 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @pmamtraveller: By Noriyoshi Ohrai. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became An Interval of Blue: Landscape painted sci-fi tableau: a broken turquoise threshold stands offset left, apart from a dominant compact black armored fragment entwined with ivory bones. Broad blue sky separates them. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Ribbed black armored nose clasped by ivory ribs, Circular metal housings interlocked with bent skeletal limbs, and Serrated upper casing and bone-bound lower edge.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
